stem: A die is thrown, so the sample space is $S=\{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6\}$. Write the event $B$ = the event of getting an odd number: tap on the number line every outcome in $B$.
solution: Go through each outcome and keep those that are odd.

hints.text: Go through every outcome of S one by one and ask whether it is odd. Some outcomes in the event are still unmarked.
Check each marked outcome again: does it satisfy the condition of the event?
Check each marked outcome against the condition of the event.
